_readme: Wave -> URL list, per content/SEO-STRATEGY.md §4. Ancestor hub pages a wave's articles need for hierarchy are pulled in automatically by generate.js even if not listed here (see tools/wxr/README.md). Pure data below the underscore-prefixed keys; generate.js ignores any key starting with '_'.
_assumptions: Wave 1 excludes '/' (home.md) — the homepage is never emitted into WXR at all (content/README.md: it's a theme template, not a WP Page, already live via front-page.php from day one). SEO-STRATEGY.md §4's '~17' wave-1 count already excludes the homepage on the same logic (6 trust + /dogs/ + /cats/ + 6 Pet Guides + 3 tools = 17); the array below emits exactly that: 17 URLs, verified against the generator's own output ('Wrote 17 page(s)'). The homepage still goes live on launch day — it's just not one of the 17 WXR-imported Pages, so don't go looking for an 18th Page in WP Admin after import.

Wave 2 lists 14 sub-hubs (8 dog + 6 cat), not the '13 (7+6)' in SEO-STRATEGY §4. /dogs/grooming/ is a fully-written 8th dog pillar added 2026-07-24, after the SEO-STRATEGY wave table was dated 2026-07-23 — it was never subtracted from wave 2, it's just missing from that table. Treated as belonging to wave 2 like every other sub-hub.

Waves 3-5 fold in the ~14 other 'NEW 24-07' dog pages (see SITEMAP.md) that postdate the SEO-STRATEGY wave table, by their content cluster: dog health NEW pages (fleas-ticks-and-worms, ear-infections) and puppy-care NEW pages (how-to-stop-puppy-biting, puppy-socialization) -> wave 3; dog food NEW pages (can-dogs-eat-grapes, can-dogs-eat-chocolate) and training NEW page (recall-training) -> wave 4; dog breeds NEW pages (large-dogs, guard-dogs, best-dogs-for-seniors) and behavior NEW pages (dog-zoomies, why-does-my-dog-stare-at-me, why-does-my-dog-dig) -> wave 5. This is the natural extension of each wave's own cluster grouping and keeps hub->article links intra-wave, per SEO-STRATEGY §4's stated design goal — flagged here for the SEO specialist to confirm rather than silently assumed.
Cats and Pet Guides clusters have no 'NEW' pages, so their wave assignments match SEO-STRATEGY §4 exactly with no judgment calls.
